events.title: Death of Pope St. Gregory VII
events.shortBlurb: The reforming pope of the Investiture Controversy, who brought the emperor to penance at Canossa, died in exile at Salerno…
body: Gregory VII (Hildebrand) was the great reforming pope who fought simony and the lay investiture of bishops, and who in 1077 brought the Emperor Henry IV to do penance in the snow at Canossa. Driven at last from Rome, he died in exile at Salerno in 1085 with the words, “I have loved justice and hated iniquity; therefore I die in exile.”
His reform reshaped the medieval Church's independence from secular power.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 25 May
